plugins.name: agent-dashboard
plugins.description: Live pane of subagents: type, task, elapsed time, tool calls and status

plugins.name: auto-compact
plugins.description: Compacts the conversation once context passes a threshold (/compact-at)

plugins.name: budget-guard
plugins.description: Daily spend budget: warns as you approach it and asks before going over (/budget)

plugins.name: done-sound
plugins.description: Chime when a long turn finishes, a different sound when it fails

plugins.name: explain-risky
plugins.description: Explains risky commands in one plain-English line while their approval prompt is open

plugins.name: guardrails
plugins.description: Blocks destructive commands and access to secret files, for Claude and its agents (/guardrails)

plugins.name: long-term-memory
plugins.description: Remembers session summaries, decisions and preferences across sessions, in a file you can edit (/brain)

plugins.name: mascot
plugins.description: A little character above the prompt that reacts to what Claude is doing (/mascot)

plugins.name: model-advisor
plugins.description: Picks Sonnet or Opus for each prompt by how hard it is (/model-advisor)

plugins.name: mods-center
plugins.description: A colourful control panel for all your mods: live status and one-key toggles (/mods)

plugins.name: next-step
plugins.description: Suggests the next prompt after each turn: run tests, fix the error, commit (Tab to take)

plugins.name: phone-alert
plugins.description: Alerts your phone through ntfy or iMessage when a long task finishes or Claude needs you while you're away (/phone-alert)

plugins.name: prompt-enhancer
plugins.description: Adds the last error and recent files behind short, vague prompts like 'fix it' (/enhancer)

plugins.name: session-hud
plugins.description: A /hud pane with time, git changes, task progress and files touched this session

plugins.name: style-rules
plugins.description: Your personal preferences added to Claude's system prompt in every session (/style)

plugins.name: tidy-view
plugins.description: One-line tool calls (/compact-tools) and a distraction-free zen mode (/zen)

plugins.name: undo-last
plugins.description: Saves files before Claude edits them so /undo-last can put back the last turn's changes

plugins.name: usage-meter
plugins.description: Warns with a toast as rate limits pass 80% and 95% (figures show in the mascot band)
